verdict.rationale: Vercel's pricing docs publish an exact on-demand rate table that applies once included amounts or credits are used up, for example Fast Data Transfer at $0.15 per GB and CDN Requests at $2.00 per 1M. Per-region Active CPU and Provisioned Memory rates for functions are tabled on a separate page. Build minutes have no overage rate in the evidence, and function invocation counts are not priced directly, only compute time and memory. Missing for 10: build-minute overage rates, an explicit per-invocation overage rate, and the actual per-region function rate figures in the evidence.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the exact overage fee schedule for exceeding plan usage limits (bandwidth, invocations, build minutes) before I get billed

citations.quote: Once you pass an included amount or use your credit, Vercel charges per unit of usage.
Fast Data Transfer: First 100 GB / Flat Rate CDN / $0.15 per 1 GB
CDN Requests: First 1,000,000 / Flat Rate CDN / $2.00 per 1,000,000 Requests
You are only billed during actual code execution and not during I/O operations
The Pro plan is billed monthly based on the number of deploying team seats, paid add-ons, and any on-demand usage during the billing period.
